basic_info.description: Spacious and light-filled, Eichler-designed single-level condominium showcases panoramic views of Pacific Heights, Japantown, and Downtown from the great room and all three bedrooms. Designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living, the open-concept layout flows effortlessly to a private terraceideal for entertaining or quiet relaxation. The residence features a newly renovated chef's kitchen, a serene primary suite, a full guest bath, and a generous walk-in laundry room with ample storage. Modern comforts include radiant in-floor heating. Set within a well-maintained elevator building offering a 24-hour front desk and tennis courts, the home also includes deeded garage parking. Ideally located just one block from Lower Pacific Heights and Japantown, within close proximity to vibrant Fillmore Street, cafs, parks, and theaters, and with easy access to regional freeways.
